scope: Targeted current-input and empty-result diagnosis of the existing collector; not broad New Zealand source research or a new programme-guide mapping.
confirmed: The current official input is HTTP 200 HTML, so the collector can reach the endpoint.
The fetched main content is a Blazor loading spinner, without a displayed calendar month, sitting-day buttons, House session status or next-meeting sentence.
The current parser returns an empty mapping for this unrecognized loading shell. That is not evidence of a legitimate no-events window, a recess or dissolution.
No programme dates or start/end times are present in the fetched input for the existing parser to recover. Asynchronous client data has not been collected in this targeted check.
date_window_notes: The request carries lang=en but no explicit month/date parameter. The parser interprets the displayed calendar month and compares dates in Pacific/Auckland.
At collection time Auckland is already on 26 October; the lack of any rendered month prevents verification of the source window. This check does not establish a separate month-window defect.

proposed_fix.change: Detect the recognizable unrendered Blazor/loading shell and raise a source-specific ValueError instead of treating it as an empty calendar.
proposed_fix.compatibility: Preserve recognized current calendar/status input and established saved-text fixtures; no date/hour synthesis or linear-guide admission.
regressions_to_add: Current sanitized Blazor/spinner shape raises rather than producing empty.
A recognized dated calendar without sitting days still represents a legitimate empty window.
Recognized next-meeting and current-sitting fixtures keep their existing behavior.

decision: The current unrendered response now produces a truthful collection error. Recognized SSR calendar/status content and explicit empty calendars remain compatible. No supported programme API or new linear-guide mapping is claimed.

verification.ruff_lint_and_format: Passed for the changed adapter and dedicated test file.

post_fix_saved_input_result.message: official calendar returned an unrendered Blazor loading shell

post_fix_collector_result.method: Offline replay of the fetched official input through the normal collector; not an additional HTTP request.
